description: CoMPAS is an open-source software tool listed in Awesome Sustainable Technology, a curated list of open-source sustainability projects under the section "Modeling", published or maintained by com-pas (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). was formed to develop open source software components related to IEC 61850 model implementation (profile management) and configuration of a power industry Protection Automation and Control System. Coverage: not geographically bound. The list files it under "Modeling" (energy-system modelling). The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (repository not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy-system modelling studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-sustainable-technology.
